== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Red Squadron X-wing]]. One column per published text state in date order (printed card, Decipher's errata, each Players Committee errata image); the stamp row describes the mark on each image. Revised, Japanese, foil and Virtual printings stay in Versions. Yellow highlights mark words changed against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.

Reprints: [[Red Squadron X-wing (Reflections II Foil)]] (10 January 2001) prints the words of the Decipher Errata 1998 column; only notation differs, so it has no column of its own.
